snippet.title: Titan Quest II | Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Titan Quest II is OUT NOW in Early Access on PC!

The Moirai have woven a long and winding thread—but fate no longer hides in shadow. The wait is over: Titan Quest II has arrived in Early Access on the Epic Games Store and Steam.

Step into a world of myth and monsters – your journey begins today.

Featuring the celebrated Greek soprano Aphrodite Patoulidou ( https://www.youtube.com/aphrodite_patoulidou )

- Links & Info -  
Steam: https://thqn.net/tq2-steam
Epic Games Store: https://thqn.net/tq2-egs
Website: https://titanquest2.thqnordic.com
